thread:
Lina M: quick sync — I'm exploring a 'peek pane' for catalog rows: tiny overlay that shows one primary perf badge, version dropdown, and an "Add to compare" micro-toggle. prototype: https://figma.redwood/peek-pane
Owen: looks promising. two immediate asks: keep keyboard discoverability (Tab should land on the toggle) and reduce badge noise when there are 4 metrics.
Nina: suggestion: show only the primary badge (latency) and reveal others behind a small chevron within the pane. chevron toggles inline expansion; keeps rows tidy.
Rafi (a11y): accessibility pointers: hover-only peek should NOT move focus. use aria-live polite for hover summaries. make the chevron and compare toggle keyboard operable and give badges full aria-labels like "Typical latency (p50): 92 milliseconds". debounce announcements (~400ms).
Owen: implementation note — use absolute overlay with transform to avoid reflow on show/hide. when the pane is opened via keyboard, focus should move into it; Esc closes and returns focus to row.
Lina M: microcopy: change badge tooltip to "Typical latency (p50)" and preview header to sentence case. also add analytics attribute `data-peek-source="catalog-row"` on the toggle.
CI-Bot: preview build created for branch feat/peek-pane (build #517) — https://staging.redwood/peek-pane
Nina: decision: prioritize keyboard/a11y fixes for the patch; chevron expansion behavior in next sprint. I'll update the docs and release notes.
Lina M: action items:
- Lina: update figma + prototype (today)
- Owen: overlay + transform animations + debounce (PR by Wed)
- Rafi: a11y test scenarios + badge label checklist
- Nina: docs + release note copy

Lina M: final note — ensure the chevron expansion does not cause the compare table selection state to jump; it should be strictly local to the pane unless user toggles "Add to compare". :white_check_mark:
